tools.name: browse_hotels
tools.description: All hotels in a place (from list_destinations), sorted by guest rating, 50 per page — with stars, guest rating, number of reviews, address, location and a link. Optional filters: minimum stars, minimum guest rating (0–10). No travel dates needed; for live prices use search_hotels.

tools.name: country_guide
tools.description: Short travel guide for a country, region or city (introduction, getting there, climate, safety …) from Wikivoyage, with a photo of the place. Always mention the source Wikivoyage and its licence CC BY-SA 4.0 with the source link.

tools.name: find_hotel
tools.description: Find a specific hotel by its name — typos and run-together names are fine (e.g. 'MeeStyleGarrage'). Optionally narrow by country (ISO code) and place. Returns the best matches with id, address, stars, rating and link; use the id with get_hotel, or search_hotels for prices.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Details of one hotel by its id (from search_hotels): address, location, stars, rating, check-in/out times, facilities, description and a link.

tools.name: get_route_idea
tools.description: Full existing travel route by id (from list_route_ideas): summary, stations with nights and reasons, best months, highlights, link.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Countries with their number of hotels, or — with a country — the places in that country with their number of hotels. Covers about 2.8 million hotels worldwide. Use the returned slugs with browse_hotels. No travel dates needed.

tools.name: list_route_ideas
tools.description: Ready-made multi-stop travel routes (stations, nights, best months, highlights) that already exist on wemake.holiday — optionally filtered by country (ISO code) and topic. Nothing is generated.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Put together a trip plan for a country from route ideas that already exist on wemake.holiday (stations, nights, best months) plus bookable experiences per station. Nothing is generated — if no route idea exists for the country/topic, say so and offer search_hotels or search_experiences instead.

tools.name: public_travel_diaries
tools.description: Travel diaries that travellers have shared publicly on wemake.holiday, optionally for one country (ISO code). Only public diaries; nothing private is ever returned.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Tours, tickets and activities in a city or region (e.g. 'Rome', 'Koh Samui'), with rating, duration, price from, and a link.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Live flight offers between two airports (IATA codes such as FRA, BKK). Round trip if return_date is given. Takes 10–25 seconds. Returns the cheapest offers with times, stops, baggage and a link.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Find hotels in a city, region, district or near a landmark for a stay, with live prices (total for the stay, per room). Optionally look for a specific hotel by name — typos and run-together names are fine. Returns up to 15 hotels with stars, guest rating, price and a link to book on wemake.holiday.
